meta.what: The standing of each wiki dictionary entry's meaning, by the rulings in docs/decisions-log.md, proposals 2, 4, 5 and 14.

grades.game: defined in the game's own material
grades.guide: defined in the printed official guide, no game source
grades.guide_website: defined only in the guide publisher's online word list (single source)
grades.source_untraced: known only from a word list whose origin could not be traced; kept and usable by the owner's ruling, with that label
grades.recorded_form: a form of a word the project already has; filed under that word
grades.reserved: a later-game word with no recorded meaning; never given one, spelling not reused
grades.name: a proper name
grades.variant: a recorded spelling variant of another word; not a separate word

meta.word_attested: where the wiki says the word itself occurs: game_text, game_data, guide_only, untraced_list_only, other, no_source
meta.caution: A grade says where the definition is cited from. A few definitions are misprinted in the Fifth Edition copy (see the doubt field), and no cited definition replaces a wiki meaning until the game source has been checked.
